verdict.rationale: Anthropic Skills documents that the `SKILL.md` format follows the open 'Agent Skills' standard which 'works across multiple AI tools' (anthropic-skills-docs-47), and community evidence shows a user successfully reusing a skill directory with Codex via AGENTS.md (anthropic-skills-comm-13). However, all official install/marketplace instructions (`/plugin marketplace add`, `/plugin install`, `/skill-name` invocation) are Claude Code-specific, and there is no first-party per-harness guidance for Codex, Cursor, or other agents — cross-agent use is a community workaround rather than a documented, supported path. Missing for 10: official per-harness install docs for Codex/Cursor/other agents, first-party confirmation of consistent behavior across harnesses, and evidence of a unified multi-agent installer.
